title: The conversation is a 720 pt column with hairlines, no cards
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData; open a conversation with 4 or more messages and make the window wide
Press Up and Down to move between messages, then hover a collapsed message and 'N older messages'
Click the recipients or the small chevron in the open message's header; press ⌘F
Switch to Dark, then turn on Increase Contrast in System Settings › Accessibility › Display
expected: The column is centred, at most 720 pt wide. A thin line starts each message: no cards, shadows or coloured bars. Collapsed messages are 36 pt rows; the focused one has a soft rounded plate (ringed with Increase Contrast); hover tints a row and nothing moves. The open header: round monogram, semibold sender, 'to …', date, Reply, Reply All, Forward, ⋯. Find floats as a glass capsule.
